widget.instructions: Press Play to run the motion; scrub the time slider to inspect any instant.

stem: A stone is dropped from rest from a tall bridge. Ignore air resistance and take g = 9.8 m/s².
How fast is it falling after {{t}} s?

hints.text: The stone starts from rest and gains speed at a steady rate.
Its speed grows by the same amount every second: that is what g measures.

fall-distance-for-speed.text: That is how far it has fallen, ½gt². The speed is g × t.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a velocity.

generic.text: v = gt for a body dropped from rest.

workedSolution.text: From rest, v = u + gt with u = 0.

fall-distance-for-speed.front: Speed after falling for t seconds from rest?
fall-distance-for-speed.back: v = g t (the distance is ½ g t²).

generic.front: Speed after falling for t s from rest?
